note: Family campground near Hopedale, open since 1970, with two stocked fishing ponds and a Saturday-night country-music stage show. The pond-side sites are tent sites and seasonal lots; nightly RV sites are on the open pull-through rows. Many sites are held by seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: Operator reservations, amenities, seasonal-rules, specials and site-map pages read: 2026 full-hookup $40 (+$2 A/C), 30/50 A water sewer, white-rock pull-throughs, May-Oct, phone/email booking with a 3-night holiday minimum. Long-stay: site map marks roughly a third of sites nightly/weekly, the rest seasonal/monthly -> keep with the caveat (already in the note). Laundry and max_rig_ft 50 unsupported by the pages; left as is.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): $40 posted for 2026 (full hook-up), under $50 -> passes. Good Sam: not a Good Sam Park (not in the directory). Gateway: not needed. Presence: live operator site with phone; Google 4.5 / 192.

LONG-STAY five tests: (1) sells nights - yes, a posted nightly rate and monthly 'specials for Nightly Campers'; (2) posted nightly rate - $40; (3) bookable for a night - yes, by phone/email, no minimum outside holidays; (4) the operator's wording welcomes overnight guests (specials, Opry weekends) and does not discourage them; (5) nightly share - the 2017 site map marks about 105 numbered 'Nightly & Weekly' sites (Tim Rd 1-20, East Area rows to the 80s) against roughly 190-200 hatched seasonal/monthly sites (all the pond-side rows, Randy/Tina/Tammy Rd, the north and south rows of the East Area): a nightly share near a third. In the 10-50% band -> keep with the long-term caveat, which the cleaned note carries ('Many sites are held by seasonal campers'). The map is from 2017; a current share was not found.

TENT-ONLY CLASSES: the $35 primitive and $36 electric-and-water classes are labelled '(tents or pop-up trailer)' with a 3-night maximum; the RV class is the $40 full-hookup site, which is the base written.
FACILITIES: stored laundry (derived from old note prose) is not on the amenities page; left alone (silence is not a contradiction).
SITES: stored max_rig_ft 50 came from old note prose; no page states a length. Not rewritten.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept; the pond-side sites on West and East Lake (small ponds) are tent sites ('Tent sites with electric and water with shade on the lakeside') or hatched seasonal lots on the map, not nightly RV sites.
